|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Princess Leia, Lost Scion]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB7-01-Princess_Leia_Lost_Scion-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]) (the Players Committee card image prints the same words, but it is its own version, [[Princess Leia, Lost Scion (Errata 2)]]). Versions in date order: [[Princess Leia, Lost Scion]] (original, release sheet of 18 June 2010); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Princess Leia, Lost Scion (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as PC-E1); [[Princess Leia, Lost Scion (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Princess Leia, Lost Scion]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 7, slip 34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Princess Leia, Lost Scion (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=13, page 13. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=13 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “34” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “Lightsaber, Leia's forfeit” to “Lightsaber, her forfeit”.<ref name="cl-1271_34-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Princess Leia, Lost Scion (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-princessleialostscion-pre.gif]]) prints the PC website card-list text ([[Princess Leia, Lost Scion (Errata)]], PC-E1) again, word for word: “While present at a battleground, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. While armed with Anakin's Lightsaber, her forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “34” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Princess Leia, Lost Scion (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 13)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Princess Leia, Lost Scion]]) again, word for word: “While present at a battleground, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. While armed with Anakin's Lightsaber, Leia's forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-34-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “34”).
